verdict.rationale: Sentry's own docs have a "Billing Quota Management" page, and the pricing page lists "Advanced quota management" on a higher tier, so quota control is a first-party capability. The pack only shows titles and tier bullets, though, with no detail on how quotas work. Missing for 10: evidence of per-project event quota caps, spend limits or on-demand budget ceilings that stop overage charges during an error storm, rate-limit or spike-protection behavior, and independent corroboration that bills stay predictable.
